THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF WONG, MICHAEL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT JMB CONSTRUCTION, INC. ESQUIVEL GRADING & PAVING INC. $8,875.66 PRINCIPAL, $105.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $8,980.66, DEFENDANT SHALL PAY PLAINTIFF: $8875.66 FOR REPAIR COSTS AND TOW CHARGE. PLAINTIFF HAS PROVIDED SUFFICIENT EVIDENCE THAT ESQUIVEL'S FAILURE TO WARN OF THE DIP CAUSED HIS DAMAGE. THIS JUDGMENT RUNS AGAINST ESQUIVEL ONLY. ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, THE JUDGMENT IN THIS ACTION HAS BEEN PAID IN FULL OR OTHERWISE SATISFIED. AS TO DEFENDANT ESQUIVEL GRADING & PAVING INC.
